explanation: Because $\pi$ radians equals $180^\circ$, you can swap $\pi$ for $180^\circ$ anywhere.

alternativeExplanations.title: A third of a half turn
steps: $\pi$ radians is a half turn, so $\frac{\pi}{3}$ is one third of a half turn.
One third of $180^\circ$ is $60^\circ$ — and $60^\circ$ is a familiar angle from equilateral triangles.
